dz: 安禄山在燕京反抗宰相杨国忠，引发了中国唐朝的安禄山之乱。
de: An Lushan revolts against Chancellor Yang Guozhong at Yanjing, initiating the An Lushan Rebellion during the Tang dynasty of China.
